Task: Fix missing JPG extensions in restricted Qt WebEngine file pickers.

Changes:

+def extra_suffixes_workaround(upstream_mimetypes: Iterable[str]) -> Set[str]:
+    """Return file suffixes missing from Qt's accepted file types.
+
+    Qt 6.2.3 through 6.6.x misses some MIME suffixes in file pickers.
+    """
+    if (not qtutils.version_check("6.2.3", compiled=False) or
+            qtutils.version_check("6.7.0", compiled=False)):
+        return set()
+
+    accepted = set(upstream_mimetypes)
+    suffixes = set()
+    for mime in accepted:
+        if mime.endswith("/*"):
+            prefix = mime[:-1]
+            suffixes.update(
+                suffix for suffix, mapped_mime in mimetypes.types_map.items()
+                if mapped_mime.startswith(prefix)
+            )
+        elif "/" in mime:
+            suffixes.update(mimetypes.guess_all_extensions(mime))
+
+    return suffixes - accepted
+

diff --git a/tests/unit/browser/webengine/test_webview.py b/tests/unit/browser/webengine/test_webview.py
index 98bf34f..0af4e8f 100644
--- a/tests/unit/browser/webengine/test_webview.py
+++ b/tests/unit/browser/webengine/test_webview.py
@@ -58,3 +58,62 @@ def test_enum_mappings(enum_type, naming, mapping):
     for name, val in members:
         mapped = mapping[val]
         assert camel_to_snake(naming, name) == mapped.name
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("at_least_623, at_least_670, expected", [
+    (False, False, set()),
+    (True, False, {".jpg", ".jpe"}),
+    (True, True, set()),
+])
+def test_extra_suffixes_workaround_version(monkeypatch, at_least_623,
+                                           at_least_670, expected):
+    def version_check(version, *, compiled):
+        assert compiled is False
+        return {"6.2.3": at_least_623, "6.7.0": at_least_670}[version]
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(webview.qtutils, "version_check", version_check)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(webview.mimetypes, "guess_all_extensions",
+                        lambda mime: [".jpg", ".jpe"])
+
+    assert webview.extra_suffixes_workaround(["image/jpeg"]) == expected
+
+
+def test_extra_suffixes_workaround_mime_and_suffixes(monkeypatch):
+    monkeypatch.setattr(webview.qtutils, "version_check",
+                        lambda version, *, compiled: version == "6.2.3")
+    extensions = {
+        "image/jpeg": [".jpg", ".jpe"],
+        "image/png": [".png"],
+        "video/mp4": [".m4v", ".mpg4"],
+    }
+    monkeypatch.setattr(webview.mimetypes, "guess_all_extensions",
+                        lambda mime: extensions[mime])
+
+    assert webview.extra_suffixes_workaround(
+        ["image/jpeg", "video/mp4"]) == {".jpg", ".jpe", ".m4v", ".mpg4"}
+    assert webview.extra_suffixes_workaround(
+        ["image/jpeg", ".jpg", ".jpe"]) == set()
+    assert webview.extra_suffixes_workaround([".jpg"]) == set()
+
+
+def test_extra_suffixes_workaround_wildcard(monkeypatch):
+    monkeypatch.setattr(webview.qtutils, "version_check",
+                        lambda version, *, compiled: version == "6.2.3")
+    monkeypatch.setattr(webview.mimetypes, "types_map", {
+        ".jpg": "image/jpeg",
+        ".jpe": "image/jpeg",
+        ".png": "image/png",
+        ".mp4": "video/mp4",
+    })
+
+    assert webview.extra_suffixes_workaround(
+        ["image/*", ".jpg"]) == {".jpe", ".png"}
+
+
+def test_extra_suffixes_workaround_real_jpeg_mapping(monkeypatch):
+    monkeypatch.setattr(webview.qtutils, "version_check",
+                        lambda version, *, compiled: version == "6.2.3")
+
+    assert {".jpg", ".jpe"} <= webview.extra_suffixes_workaround(
+        ["image/jpeg"])
+    assert ".jpg" in webview.extra_suffixes_workaround(["image/*"])
